packageRules.description: moenarch-* crates are consumed from exact source pins (.coding-tooling.source-deps.json); their version bumps belong to the coordinated release task (docs/source-development.md, #438), not Renovate.

asr-candle-* are Cargo aliases (depName; packageName is candle-*) that keep native-whisperx's ASR path on the same Candle 0.10 as audio-analysis (patched via [patch.crates-io], docs/source-development.md). Bumping them alone pulls candle 0.11 in twice under different names and breaks cargo metadata; they move only with audio-analysis's Candle version.
